raw_text: Three files on the public robolawyer-tm.github.io site were updated: index.html, llms.txt, and llms-full.txt. The goal was to point their references at the inference documents now hosted in the vivify-operators repository, such as cross_scale_significance.md. Because llms.txt and llms-full.txt are machine-readable discovery files for language models, keeping them aligned with the current repository layout means automated readers and humans both reach the correct theory documents after the reorganization.
